text:
Harper: Heads-up  we need the launch blog locked by 17:00 PT so ops can queue the webinar flow and social. who has final editorial?
Lee: I have editorial. synced with the author, trimmed the intro to 2 paragraphs. uploaded final to Drive: https://drive.redwood/launch-draft-v3
Noor: Quick legal flag  the line 'cuts inference unit cost 70%' is too absolute. @Priya can you advise on safe language/tests required?
Priya: please change to 'up to 70% lower per-token cost in our internal tests' and link to benchmark repo. also we need a stats source for the hero badge.
Kaya: can do. Where should the benchmark link point? I'd prefer the public gist or the benchmarks PR once merged.
Ben: Benchmarks live in /benchmarks/optimize-q1-2026. I'll open a public-facing summary PR and paste the link here when ready. ETA 2 hours.
Harper: Good. Next  CTA and webinar routing. Do we want a single CTA that both registers and drops the playbook, or separate?
Lee: single CTA performed best in the AB test. CTA copy: 'Get the playbook + RSVP' (keeps character count low).
Kaya: HubSpot form ID is f7e9-12a0. Routing rule: company_employees > 500 => AE_Pool_Enterprise; revenue_estimate > 10M => AE_Pool_Enterprise; otherwise MQL nurture. Can we add a hidden field 'source_blog=launch_v2'?
Noor: Hidden field fine. Also please ensure PII is not auto-captured. legal requires explicit consent checkbox on the form.
Ben: I'm adding the hidden field and consent markup. snippet below for the CTA and hidden field:

<button id="cta-lead" data-hs-form-id="f7e9-12a0">Get the playbook + RSVP</button>
<form style="display:none">
  <input type="hidden" name="source_blog" value="launch_v2"/>
  <input type="checkbox" name="consent_marketing" required/> I agree to receive product updates.
</form>
<script>window.location.href = window.location.href + '?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=launch_post&utm_campaign=launch_v2';</script>

Harper: Perfect. EngRuntime, can you confirm analytics payload keys? We want blog_post, campaign, author_id, utm params.
EngRuntime: we'll smoke-test the analytics event in staging. tagging @eng-runtime to run the test at 08:00 PT tomorrow. expect pass/fail by 08:15.
Priya: legal approves 'up to 70% lower per-token cost in our internal tests' + bench link once Ben posts it. No other blockers.
Lee: updated the meta description to 152 chars and tightened H1. also removed an unsupported claim around 'enterprise-proven'  marketing ops asked to avoid that without customer quotes.
Kaya: Social copy drafted and added to the tracking sheet. will queue LinkedIn short + Twitter thread. UTMs match the CTA snippet above.
Harper: one more: image alt text for hero (for accessibility)  status?
Ben: I added alt text and image credits in the doc.
Noor: LegalBot: running final check...
LegalBot: :white_check_mark: Automated checks OK, manual review needed for benchmarking language. Priya confirmed.
Ben: PR for benchmark summary merged. public link: https://github.com/redwood/benchmarks/optimize-q1-2026#summary
Priya: added legal-approved sentence and pinned the benchmark link in the draft.
Harper: all items green? checklist:
- editorial final (Lee)  done
- legal language + benchmark link (Priya)  done
- CTA + form hidden field & consent (Ben)  done
- hubspot routing rules (Kaya)  done
- image alt + credits (Ben)  done
- analytics event QA (EngRuntime)  scheduled
- social + tracking sheet (Kaya)  done

Lee: I'll merge the content PR after EngRuntime confirms analytics in staging.
EngRuntime: analytics smoke test passed at 08:05 PT in staging. payload contains: blog_post, campaign, author_id, utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign.
Harper: thanks. Lee, please merge when ready and then I'll flip publish gate. publishing window set for 2026-04-09 10:00 PT.
Lee: merging now.
PublishBot: :robot_face: Post scheduled for 2026-04-09 17:00 UTC. Internal note will be sent 15 minutes post-publish with leads and first-hour traffic.
Harper: closing the thread. great work all! remember to monitor lead queue for the first 2 hours and escalate any routing errors to @Kaya.
Noor: will watch for consent opt-ins.
Ben: logging benchmark snapshot to the analytics doc for the post.
Harper: last_message_ts updated.
